ai.summary: A portrait English speaking-journal template: two-sentence captions, inline strike-through corrections, repeat-mistake emphasis, full-transcript recap and original-text score. The CURRENT HOST AI does correction and scoring from measured word timestamps; no extra LLM API key or model endpoint is needed. Scripts prepare audit-task.json, the host AI writes audit.json following scripts/audit-prompt.md, then scripts apply it locally. Read guide.json, README.md, params.schema.json and runtime-profile.md. The synthetic demo needs no keys. Optional ElevenLabs narration uses the recipient's own key only when requested. This is an independent content package with a documented custom Remotion adapter, not a signed MotionGit personal-download package.
